title: Before the Sun Rises
description: Tomato pickers begin work early in the morning to avoid the day’s worst heat in Los Baños, California, in the San Joaquin Valley. As temperatures rise, extreme heat is expected to make outdoor agricultural work increasingly dangerous.
translated_description: 在加利福尼亚州圣华金谷的洛斯巴诺斯，采摘西红柿的工人一大早就开始工作，以避开一天中最酷热的时段。随着气温升高，极端高温预计将使户外农业工作变得越来越危险。
